description: This file contains an internal sealed class implementation of a tuned blocked Bloom filter, which is a probabilistic data structure used for set membership testing with a controllable false positive rate. The class includes methods for constructing the filter, adding elements, checking containment, and resetting the filter. The implementation uses regression coefficients to tune the false positive rate, and it references external hashing functions and other utility methods.

classes.name: BlockedBloomFilter
classes.description: A tuned version of a blocked Bloom filter implementation designed to optimize false positive rates within a specified range, using polynomial regression for calibration.

methods.name: BlockedBloomFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Bloom filter with capacity and desired false positive rate, performing validation and calculation of internal parameters.

methods.name: RegressFpRate
methods.description: Computes an adjusted false positive rate via polynomial regression based on the provided target rate.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an element (identified by GrainId) to the Bloom filter by hashing and setting bits accordingly.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an element (identified by GrainId) is potentially in the filter.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears the filter by resetting all bits.

methods.name: GetBlockIndex
methods.description: Calculates the index of the block within the filter array based on the hash.

methods.name: ComputeMask1
methods.description: Generates a bitmask from the hash for setting or checking bits in the first part of the filter.

methods.name: ComputeMask2
methods.description: Generates a bitmask from the hash for setting or checking bits in the second part of the filter.
